experiment: Independent recurrent-depth denoising pilot; not a Huginn/DiffusionBlocks paper replication
train_source: all WikiText2 train bytes; uniform random windows with replacement
evaluation: 256 disjoint evenly spaced windows from official test;128 validation; final32 of64 shifted targets scored
decoder: Arithmetic mean of final softmax over four fixed independent target-free Gaussian particles; next-byte log-score, NOT exact diffusion/greedy sampler likelihood
noise: log sigma Normal(-1.2,1.2), clamped [.002,80]; codebook learned with unit L2 rows; EDM sigma_data.5
weighted: Primary diffusion: CE weighted (sigma^2+.25)/(sigma*.5)^2, divided by FIXED 500 for numerical loss scale; same relative weights. Secondary unweighted CE predeclared.
inference: 4 Karras rho7 levels80 to.002, Euler with negative dt, posterior mean normalized embedding, last logits
baseline: Exact same recurrent architecture/inference graph, full 4-step BPTT from noise; not original Huginn32 with8 truncation
transformer: 2-layer causal Transformer same width/context, secondary comparator, fewer noise-conditioning parameters
matching: Same seed/init shared recurrent models; same first600 batches; additionally continue each cheaper method until baseline600 cumulative CPU training time, cap3000. Timing excludes data extraction and validation/test, includes optimizer/loss
compute: Single CPU thread shared scratch; actual process/wall training seconds; no paid resources
selection: No test-based selection; all seeds, methods, equal-data and equal-CPU endpoints reported. Validation diagnostic only.
limits: 1200 process CPU seconds entire training process; final artifact contains all checkpoints
